summary: Day 69 of 72 (Exam Hall Tactical Protocol Lockdown & Mental Rehearsal): Rehearse the exact 40-minute battle plan for VARC, DILR, and QA. Zero new problem solving.

urgent_alerts.title: CAT 2026 Examination Day
urgent_alerts.action: National CAT exam: 68 questions in 120 minutes (VARC 24, DILR 22, QA 22). Report 1 hr before allocated slot.

blocks.title: DSA Algorithmic Problem Solving (2 Problems)
blocks.details: Solve 2 curated LeetCode problems (1 Medium + 1 Easy/Review) from the 247-problem DSA Tracker. Focus on algorithmic clarity and edge cases.

blocks.title: Job Search Recruiter Triage & Screening Replies
blocks.details: 15–30 min recruiter communications triage: reply to inbound messages, confirm availability, schedule technical screenings, and follow up on pending submissions.

blocks.title: CAT Day 69: QA & DILR Focus
blocks.details: QA: QA Tactical Plan: 40 Mins = Round 1 (18 mins, 6 easy Qs) + Round 2 (18 mins, 4 medium Qs) + 4 mins buffer.. DILR: DILR Tactical Plan: 40 Mins = 5 mins scan/rank 4 sets + 16 mins Set 1 + 16 mins Set 2 + 3 mins check..

blocks.title: CAT 2026 High-Yield Revision & Error Log
blocks.details: Post-freeze study sprint: Review flagged weak areas, formula shortcuts, and recent mock exam error log entries.

blocks.title: CAT Day 69: VARC & Verbal Ability
blocks.details: VARC Tactical Plan: 40 Mins = 3 Passages (24 mins) + 8 VA Questions (14 mins) + 2 mins buffer. Maintain error log on Career Launcher MyZone.
